data.author: jburzy
data.body:
EDM4hep 1.2 stores a time error per tracker hit (key4hep/EDM4hep#528), and DDPlanarDigi now fills it with the digitization time resolution (key4hep/k4Reco#74). CKFTrackingAlg now takes the time resolution of each hit from its time error, for both the 4D CKF measurement and the seeding time cuts. HitTimeResolutions is kept as a fallback for hits without a time error, e.g. files digitized before EDM4hep 1.2. It is no longer required when hit time is used, and the placeholder warning is removed. A hit with neither throws. The time error is read only when building against EDM4hep 1.2 or newer.

data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
Follow-up from a sixth review pass; the finding was reproduced first.

Discovery hashed reachable files and resources without error handling, so an unreadable resource (e.g. mode 000) raised a raw `PermissionError` and `k4opt geometry inspect` printed a traceback. The failure is now an `IncludeError` naming the file, reported by the CLI like any other error.

Regression test included.

data.title: Geometry: fingerprint verified resource hashes, drop externals of unreachable files
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
Follow-ups from a fifth review pass; each finding was checked against the code first.

- `compute_fingerprint` takes the resource hashes `materialize` already verified instead of rehashing the source, so the fingerprint always describes the bytes that were published (and large CAD files are not hashed twice).
- The manifest keeps outside-root external references only for files still reachable in the edited snapshot.

Not changed: redirecting a plain symbolic `ref` (e.g. `Si`) to a missing path is still accepted, since plain names are deliberately not treated as filenames.

Each fix has a regression test.

data.title: Geometry: external-to-local resource redirects, duplicate externals, staging errors
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
Follow-ups from a fourth review pass; each finding was checked against the code first.

- Reject redirecting an external file-like resource reference (e.g. `${CAD_DIR}/x.stl`) to a local file that does not exist; plain names are still not assumed to be files.
- Record the structural locator of external references so the manifest drops only the edited reference, not unchanged ones with the same value.
- Turn failures while preparing the output location, or hashing a new resource, into `MaterializationError` instead of a traceback.

Each fix has a regression test.

data.title: Geometry: edit read-only sources, reject unrelocatable resources, manifest externals
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
Follow-ups from a third review pass; each finding was checked against the code first.

- Make staged copies owner-writable so geometries from read-only installations can be edited (previously "Permission denied" for any override).
- Reject redirecting a resource `ref` to a file outside the geometry root, which cannot resolve from a relocated snapshot.
- Take the manifest's external includes from the edited snapshot instead of the original catalog.
- Check for an existing output before the plain-rename fallback of the atomic publish (it stays best-effort where `renameat2` is unavailable, e.g. NFS).
- Report non-UTF-8 configuration files as config errors.

Not addressed: symlink aliases and redirecting an XML include outside the include closure. Both fail loudly with nothing written; a prope…

data.title: Geometry: complete resource handling, atomic publication, YAML loader fixes
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
Follow-ups from a second review pass; each finding was checked against the code first.

- Reject redirecting a resource `ref` to a file that does not exist (external references and plain names still allowed).
- List redirected resources in the manifest, matching what the fingerprint covers.
- Publish with `renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE)` (plain rename as fallback) so the output is never visible empty and never replaced; replaces the earlier `mkdir` reservation.
- Refuse a geometry that already contains the manifest filename.
- YAML loader: merge keys work again; unhashable keys give a config error instead of a `TypeError`.
- `setup.sh`: check the stack, the `cvmfs-venv` download and the pytest fallback.

Not addressed: symlink aliases and redirecting an XML include to a file outside the inclu…

data.title: Geometry: fix fingerprint and materialization correctness issues
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
Fixes from a full repository review, each verified against the code before implementing (one commit per fix).

- Verify every copied XML file and resource against the discovery hashes, not only files with overrides (stale catalogs could yield a fingerprint that did not match the output).
- Copy and fingerprint resource files that an override redirects a `ref` to (previously a silently incomplete snapshot).
- Do not rewrite XML for overrides that restate the current value.
- Publish the output atomically without ever replacing a directory that appeared during materialization.
- Reject override values that are not valid XML text instead of raising a raw `ValueError`.
- Reject duplicate keys in the YAML configuration.

data.title: Fix CI: make the source-root test independent of git, skip hooks in CI
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
The first CI run failed in the `test` job with one failing unit test.

- `test_environment_variables_are_expanded` assumed the checkout is recognized as a git repository. In the CI container the workspace is owned by another user, so git refuses it and root detection correctly falls back to the file's directory. The expected compact path is now derived from the detected root.
- `setup.sh` no longer installs the git hooks when `CI` is set: nobody commits there, and downloading the hook environments is wasted time.

Checked locally: lint, strict mypy and the unit tests pass; in a clean copy with `CI=true` the 127 unit tests pass and the hook step is skipped.
